title: California 'architect' of 19th century native American genocide, 'US govt 'funded' most of killing'
summary: Eve Irvine is pleased to welcome Benjamin Madley, History Professor at UCLA and author of 'An American Genocide: The United States and the California Indian Catastrophe, 1846-1873'.
